process.title: 实现 numwords.py 整数转英文词及其测试
process.scope: Owns only numwords.py and tests/test_numwords.py. Does not own code39.py, solids.py, any existing repository file, or any team/ file.
process.task:
Create two NEW files only: numwords.py and tests/test_numwords.py. Do not modify any existing file. Use only the Python standard library. Do not import code39 or solids or any non-stdlib module.

Implement number_to_words(n: int) -> str in numwords.py:
- Range pinned to 0 <= n <= 999,999,999. n must be int; bool is rejected (TypeError). Non-int input raises TypeError; out-of-range input raises ValueError.
- Spelling rules pinned: American English, no "and", all lowercase, grouped by thousand/million; within a group the hundreds place is "X hundred"; tens and ones combine with a hyphen (e.g. forty-two); single space between words/groups, no leading or trailing spaces.

Acceptance examples (each must have a corresponding test case in tests/test_numwords.py, exact string equality):
- number_to_words(0) == "zero"
- number_to_words(5) == "five"
- number_to_words(13) == "thirteen"
- number_to_words(20) == "twenty"
- number_to_words(40) == "forty"
- number_to_words(42) == "forty-two"
- number_to_words(99) == "ninety-nine"
- number_to_words(100) == "one hundred"
- number_to_words(115) == "one hundred fifteen" (no "and")
- number_to_words(999) == "nine hundred ninety-nine"
- number_to_words(1000) == "one thousand"
- number_to_words(1001) == "one thousand one"
- number_to_words(1100) == "one thousand one hundred"
- number_to_words(12345) == "twelve thousand three hundred forty-five"
- number_to_words(100000) == "one hundred thousand"
- number_to_words(1000000) == "one million"
- number_to_words(2000000) == "two million"
- number_to_words(100000000) == "one hundred million"
- number_to_words(999999999) == "nine hundred ninety-nine million nine hundred ninety-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine"
- number_to_words(-1) raises ValueError
- number_to_words(1000000000) raises ValueError
- number_to_words(2.5) raises TypeError
- number_to_words("42") raises TypeError
- number_to_words(True) raises TypeError

Every acceptance item above must be covered by a test case. No conflicts between body and acceptance were found for this module.
